mapper.select: WITH months AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -LEVEL + 1), 'MONTH'), 'YYYY-MM') AS YEAR_MONTH FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) SELECT m.YEAR_MONTH, NVL(COUNT(DISTINCT r.OCCUREDDATE), 0) AS FX, NVL(COUNT(DISTINCT b.CREATETIME), 0) AS NK, NVL(COUNT(DISTINCT p.CREATETIME), 0) AS SJ FROM months m LEFT JOIN TBL_RISKEVENT r ON TO_CHAR(TRUNC(r.OCCUREDDATE, 'MONTH'), 'YYYY-MM') = m.YEAR_MONTH LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_BUG b ON TO_CHAR(TRUNC(b.CREATETIME, 'MONTH'), 'YYYY-MM') = m.YEAR_MONTH LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT p ON TO_CHAR(TRUNC(p.CREATETIME, 'MONTH'), 'YYYY-MM') = m.YEAR_MONTH GROUP BY m.YEAR_MONTH ORDER BY m.YEAR_MONTH
